predecessors.name: Turkestan ASSR
predecessors.text: the Transcaspian Oblast, held by the Tashkent Soviet until the revolt of July 1918

successors.name: Turkestan ASSR
successors.text: regained by the Tashkent Soviet by 1920

ledger.x: 1918: Ashgabat rises against the Tashkent Bolsheviks.
1918: the committee becomes the Trans Caspian Provisional Government.

wars.name: Transcaspian campaign (Malleson mission)
wars.outcome: The Ashkhabad government, helped by the Anglo-Indian Malleson mission, held Transcaspia until the British withdrew; by 1920 the Tashkent Soviet had regained it.

certainty.note: A rebel regime on the railway line from Krasnovodsk to Ashgabat; no frontier is described.
